name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Gold Token SA issues DGLD natively on Ethereum and Base; per-chain token proxies are administered by the issuer's own EOAs (mint-authority review 2026-07-16). No third-party bridge carries the representation.

mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a single issuer EOA that also owns the ProxyAdmin. After retiring the compromised Ethereum-Base bridge, the issuer deployed an independently gold-backed native Base token whose MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and ProxyAdmin owner are separately identified.

mintIncidents.summary: An exploit of the former Ethereum-Base bridge enabled unauthorized unbacked DGLD minting on Base. Gold Token SA retired that bridge, deployed a separately backed native Base token on June 30, and completed the legacy Base balance reset on July 15.

upgradeability.controlRef: DGLD Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner — issuer EOA

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540331, DGLD's MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and its ProxyAdmin owner all resolve to issuer EOA 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d. At Base block 48678413, the replacement native DGLD token's MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and ProxyAdmin owner all resolve to issuer EOA 0xe003a81a40803fedb701870c589c0a96d14544a0. Both transparent-proxy implementations and immediate upgrade paths are recorded. The issuer's February bridge-mint incident was resolved by retiring the bridge and replacing the Base deployment. DGLD's bar registry (explorer.dgld.ch) is published by MKS PAMP, which acquired full ownership of issuer Gold Token SA in 2026, so it is not an independent third-party reconciliation; a February 2026 bridge exploit also minted unbacked DGLD on Base undetected, undercutting the real-time backing claim, and no dated independent assurance report of the physical gold was found, so reconciliation is not credibly established. Gold Token SA's only regulatory touchpoint is VQF AML self-regulatory membership, not prudential supervision, so supervision is none.
